<div class="card-body">
'''Tiree''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊タイリー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に2を加える。ゴールド2に乗っているなら、さらに回避値に1を加え（「デス・スター：トレンチ」において、「アタック・ラン」の合計値に1を加える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Tiree-PSA-157709604.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ヤヴィンの戦いにおいて、デス・スター・トレンチへのアタック・ラン敢行の際、ゴールド2を駆ってゴールド・リーダーの護衛役を勤めた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tiree.

'''Card text:'''
Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If aboard Gold 2, also adds 1 to maneuver (and adds 1 to the total of Attack Run at Death Star: Trench.

'''Lore:'''
At the Battle of Yavin, during the attack run on the Death Star trench, he flew Gold 2 as cover for Gold Leader.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tiree]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
